# DRAFT — INCOMPLETE: 10 placeholder values unresolved
# Placeholder inputs pending user details

| Placeholder key                    | Needed detail                                    | Example value            |
|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| PLACEHOLDER_INTAKE_CHANNEL         | How orders arrive                                | webhook (POST /orders)   |
| PLACEHOLDER_VALIDATION_SERVICE     | System/tool that validates order data            | internal validation API  |
| PLACEHOLDER_CREDIT_CHECK_SYSTEM    | Credit-check system of record                    | ERP credit module        |
| PLACEHOLDER_INVENTORY_SYSTEM       | Inventory/stock system                           | WMS API                  |
| PLACEHOLDER_BACKORDER_POLICY       | Out-of-stock handling                            | wait-and-retry, max 5    |
| PLACEHOLDER_PREPAYMENT_REQUEST     | How prepayment requests are sent on credit fail  | ERP dunning module       |
| PLACEHOLDER_SHIPPING_PROVIDER      | Carrier/shipping integration                     | UPS API                  |
| PLACEHOLDER_INVOICING_SYSTEM       | Invoice generation/delivery                      | ERP billing              |
| PLACEHOLDER_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT        | How long to wait before payment reminder         | P14D                     |
| PLACEHOLDER_REMINDER_CADENCE       | Reminder frequency and max attempts              | P7D, max 3               |
| PLACEHOLDER_PAYMENTS_LEDGER        | Where payments are recorded                      | ERP finance module       |
